text:
sara: FYI eu-west1c is noisywe're getting a cascade of tiny-job evictions and a lot of churn on GPU nodes
mike: noticed high eviction rate + many tiny 1m inference jobs bouncing between nodes
sara: quick grep shows some nodes came up with image tag `redwood-gpu:v2-legacy` while others have `redwood-gpu:stable` driver args differ and the topology label `nvidia-topo` is missing on the legacy ones
cheng: so scheduler packs then later a gang job that requires nvlink forces eviction to consolidate, causing a repack spiral
infra-oncall: ran this to validate:
```
kubectl get nodes -l region=eu-west1c -o custom-columns=NODE:.metadata.name,IMG:.spec.providerID,TOPO:.metadata.labels.nvidia-topo --no-headers
```
infra-oncall: sample:
```
node-a1  gce://redwood-us/redwood-gpu:v2-legacy  none
node-b2  gce://redwood-us/redwood-gpu:stable     nvlink
node-c3  gce://redwood-us/redwood-gpu:stable     nvlink
node-d4  gce://redwood-us/redwood-gpu:v2-legacy  none
```
mike: root cause likely the autoscaler invoking two different provisioner images during a scale-up storm when a transient NAT/conntrack error hit the image registry mirror
sara: short term mitigation: cordon the legacy-image nodes and move tiny jobs into the warmpool. I'll do a rolling reprovision to stable image tonight
cheng: scheduler change we discussed: treat `nvidia-topo=nvlink` as a soft-preference for mixed-gang node selection and add a 2m grace period before evicting tiny jobs for consolidation. That should prevent immediate churn
infra-oncall: opened alert rule: `sum(rate(kube_pod_evictions_total[5m])) by (cluster,region) > 4 AND count(node_label_mismatch{label="nvidia-topo"}) > 0` -> notifies eng-platform oncall
ops-bot: alert created: https://go/alerts/RED-evict-euw1c-1752345678
mike: cost note: these churn events spike preemptible/GPU recharges and we burn extra node-hours. lowering packing weight for <2m pods helps both churn and cost. Can we patch scheduler config to weight by historical pod runtime?
cheng: we can add a tiny-job weight multiplier (0.2) in the scoring function and a runtime-decay so very short jobs don't trigger binpack compaction heuristics immediately
sara: proceeding with cordon/drain on the two legacy nodes now: `kubectl cordon node-a1 && kubectl drain node-a1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data` then reprovision to `redwood-gpu:stable` image and force label reconciliation
infra-oncall: cordon + drain started, moving ~9 pods; ETA ~4m
mike: also disabling the descheduler canary in eu-west1c for the next 30m, it looks like it's amplifying churn when combined with the image mix
cheng: I'll open a small PR for the scheduler soft-preference + tiny-job weight change, and add an e2e that simulates image-mix to avoid regressions
sara: filing ticket with node list, kubectl describe dumps, and cost delta estimate. follow-up actions: reprovision nodes, hard-pin autoscaler provisioner image, add label-drift alert, adjust scheduler weights
infra-oncall: will run a one-off check after reprovision to ensure `nvidia-topo` parity across the AZ
sara: thanks team, will keep the thread updated once reprovision completes :thumbsup:
